RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 25, 2004/Bhadrapada 3, 1926 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources;

Total  number of questions — 20

Electrification of villages in Uttar
Pradesh
*421. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH: Will
the Minister of  POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of villages in Uttar Pradesh
where electrification is yet to be done;
(b) the details of Government's rural
electrification scheme; and
(c) by when electrification work in all
the villages in Uttar Pradesh will be done
by Government?
1000 MW power plant in Maharashtra
*422. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA : Will
the Minister of  POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that NTPC had
decided to set up a 1000 MW power plant
at Mauda in Nagpur district of Maharashtra
and so far about Rs. one crore has already
been spent;
(b) the present status of this power
project and by when it is likely to be
completed; and
(c) the total deficit of power in Vidarbha
and Marathwada regions of Maharashtra
and what steps are proposed to be taken
to meet the total demand?
Crimes in metropolitan cities
†*423. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of  HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
take any effective steps to deal with
increasing crimes in metropolitan cities;
(b) if so, the schemes being formulated
for this purpose; and
(c) the details of the steps being taken
to implement the schemes?
Dabhol Power Project
*424. SHRI  SANJAY NIRUPAM:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government of
Maharashtra has submitted a proposal to
restart the Dabhol Power Project;

power tariff payable by Government of
Maharashtra and Central Government
organisations to the consumers; and

New strategy to tackle naxalite
menace
*425. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are evolving a
new strategy following the recent meet of
State Chief Secretaries and DGs to tackle
the growing menace of naxalism in various
States;
(b) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
by the Centre;
(c) whether the Indian naxal groups have
links with foreign elements; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Criminal acts of Delhi Police
personnel
†*426. SHRI  ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of criminal acts
committed by the police personnel in
Delhi between January 1, 2004 to July 31,
2004;
(b)  how the figures compare with those
of the last year; and
(c) the details of the steps Government
are taking to curb the incidents of criminal
acts being committed by the police
personnel in Delhi?
Problems of powerloom owners in
Maharashtra
*427. SHRI  SANJAY RAJARAM
RAUT: Will the Minister of  TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
powerloom owners in Maharashtra are

Government's help; and
(b) if so, the details of effective steps
taken for the benefit of powerloom sector
in Maharashtra?
Special Modernisation Fund for
textile industry
*428. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of  TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
Special Modernisation Fund for the entire
textile industry to help it face international
competition;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the quantum of loans and grants,
separately that will be given; and
(d) the details of other facilities
Government propose to give to the textile
industry to meet foreign competition?
Steps taken for flood affected people
*429. SHRI  SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that floods have
played havoc in Bihar, Assam and other
parts of India due to excess rain water flow
from higher lands;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

129
(b) if so, the details of the lives,
property and crops lost in the flood
affected areas;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
mitigate the sufferings of flood affected
people; and
(d) the action taken to prevent floods in
flood prone areas?
Killings of old aged persons
†*430. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI :
Will the Minister of  HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
old aged people are continuously being
killed in various parts of the country
whereby Government's claim about their
security have been exposed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the measures being
taken by Government to protect the old
aged people?
Power generation capacity of power
plants
†*431. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) the power generation capacity of
each power plant in the country with State-
wise details thereof;
(b) the demand and generation of power
in the country during each of the last three
years; and
(c) the additional capacity required to
meet the demand of power in the
country?
Allocation of funds to Chhattisgarh
under PMGSY
*432. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of  RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Chhattisgarh requires Rs. 550 crores every
year for construction of 5000 kms. a year
of  rural roads under Pradhan Mantri Gram
Sadak Yojana;
(b) if so, whether Government have
received any proposal from the State
Government and if so, action taken thereon;
and
(c) whether Government would
consider allocating more funds to the State
for the construction of rural roads to
achieve the target in time?
Scheme for upgrading the handloom
and handicraft industry
*433. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of  TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any scheme to
upgrade handloom and handicraft industry
and technology;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the action taken thereon and funds allotted
State-wise for the last three years, year-
wise and category-wise;
(c) whether there is any scheme to
upgrade the textile technology;
(d) if so, the details thereof including the
funds provided for the purpose to each
institution and the States in which these
institutions are located for last three years,
year-wise, State-wise and category-wise; and
(e) the total export of handlooms and
other textile products for the last three years,
year-wise, State-wise and category-wise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

130
Athens Olympics
†*434. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state the steps taken
by Government to increase the medal
winning prospects of Indian sportspersons
at the Athens Olympics?
Illegal Bangladeshis in Delhi
*435. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more
than 13 lakhs illegal Bangladeshi
nationals are living in Delhi and Delhi
Police has shown its inability to deport
them;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
and
(c) whether these illegal Bangladeshis
are involved in many of the heinous crimes/
dacoities in Delhi?
Mathania Solar Energy Plant in
Rajasthan
†*436. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
installation and construction work of
Mathania Solar Energy Plant in Jodhpur
district of Rajasthan is pending for more
than a decade;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
and
(c) by when it is likely to be started and
completed?
Compensation to the BSF bus bomb
blast victims
*437. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) how much compensation was
offered to the victims of Jammu and
Kashmir bomb blast in a BSF bus;
(b) the details thereof; and
(c) what steps have been taken by the
Central Government to ensure the speedy
and just delivery of the compensation
package to the victims?
Modernisation of Indian Navy
*438. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
steps to modernise the Indian Navy keeping
in view the increased strategic and economic
importance of Indian Ocean and hostile
postures of some of its neighbours; and
(b) whether modern ships have been
added to Indian Navy and aged ships have
been phased out?
Increase in custodial deaths
*439. SHRIMATI  JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the custodial deaths in
various States are on increase;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) if so, the State-wise total number of
custodial deaths that have occurred from
2003-04 to 2004-05;
(c) whether Union Government are
considering any legislation to check
increase in custodial deaths in various
States;
(d) if so, whether Government have
discussed this issue with the State Home
Ministers; and
(e) if so, what are the steps being
considered in this regard?
Rural development prosperity through
connectivity (RUPCON)
*440. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether a multi-pronged plan for
ushering in rural development prosperity
through connectivity (RUPCON) has been
unveiled;
(b) whether it is also a fact that "10
immediate missions" to achieve the goals
of rural development are proposed to be
set up; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

Secret and confidential defence
information on Internet
2244.  SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether secret and confidential
information relating to defence is still
available on Internet;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken to identify and
punish the guilty?
Spying by 'USS Bowditch' inside
India's EEZ
2245.  SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Naval headquarters have
sent a detailed note to the Ministry of
Defence raising serious objections about an
American warship "USS Bowditch" spying
consistently for several months in 2002-
2003 and carrying out unauthorised exercises
off the Visakhapatnam coast well inside
India's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ); and
(b) if so, the action Government
proposes to take against the American
warship for this illegal act against
international rules?
Constitution of a Commission
for ex-servicemen
†2246.  SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is any proposal for
constituting a Commission to formulate a
comprehensive policy with a view to study
and sort out the problems of ex-
servicemen; and
(b) if so, the details of steps to be taken
in this regard?
Crash of MiG and Mirage Jet fighters
2247.  SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) how many MiG and Mirage Jet
fighter Planes have crashed in the last five
years;
(b) the number of Pilots killed in such
mishaps; and
(c) Government’s reaction thereto and
the preventive action taken to avert such
mishaps?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Border roads in Jammu and Kashmir
2248.  SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:

States;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
increase the length of border roads in J&K,

2249.  SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:

prepared for this purpose; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

with their counterparts in the Central
Secretariat;

above parity has been disturbed by revision

Central Secretariat;

restoration of the above pay parity; and

finalisation of the case in respect of both

2003;

is facing problems of non-availability of
steel of required high quality for
manufacturing aircraft carrier warships;

procurement of such steel; and

completed?

(c) the action taken/proposed to be
taken to normalize the situation?
